instruct: An elderly man's voice in his seventies, low-to-medium in pitch and gravelly, with a dry rasp and a faint tremor at the edges; slow, deliberate and unhurried, carrying the worn, unshakable authority of a lifelong craftsman — for expressive character dialogue.
refText: Portez ce vieux whisky au juge blond qui fume, et demandez-vous ce que demain réserve.
